name: SORTTEST.jcl
description:
This JCL job filters and sorts daily credit card transaction records from a backup dataset, extracting only those transactions processed on a specific date (2022-06-02) and writing the results to a new generation of a Generation Data Group (GDG) output dataset. The job serves as a daily transaction extraction process, isolating transactions by processing date and organizing them by card number.Key Functionalities:
Reads credit card transaction records from the current generation (generation 0) of the backup dataset AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.BKUP
Filters transactions to include only those with a processing date (located at position 305, length 10) equal to 2022-06-02
Sorts the filtered transactions in ascending order by Transaction Card Number (located at position 263, length 16, in Zoned Decimal format)
Writes the sorted and filtered output to a new generation (+1) of the GDG dataset AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.DALY, cataloging it upon successful completion or deleting it on failure

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Backup File (current generation: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.BKUP(0)) is available and contains transaction records with varying Transaction Processing Dates (TRAN-PROC-DT) across multiple days
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The SORT utility evaluates each transaction record from the Transaction Backup File against the reference date '2022-06-02' (PARM-DATE)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Only transaction records where the Transaction Processing Date (TRAN-PROC-DT) is exactly equal to '2022-06-02' are INCLUDED in the output Daily Transaction File; all transaction records where the Transaction Processing Date does NOT equal '2022-06-02' are EXCLUDED and permanently discarded from the output

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05R - SORT - Daily Transaction Date Filtering
rules.Rule_Description: Only transaction records that were processed on a specific date (June 2, 2022) are selected from the full Transaction Backup File and carried forward into the Daily Transaction File. All other records are discarded.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Transaction records from the Transaction Backup File have been filtered to retain only those with a Transaction Processing Date equal to '2022-06-02'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The SORT utility arranges the filtered transaction records for output
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All qualifying transaction records are sorted by Card Number (TRAN-CARD-NUM, 16-digit numeric field) in ascending order — from the lowest card number to the highest card number — in the resulting Daily Transaction File

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05R - SORT - Transaction Sequencing by Card Number
rules.Rule_Description: After filtering, all qualifying daily transactions are arranged in ascending Card Number order so that the Daily Transaction File is delivered in a consistent, ordered sequence.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The SORT utility has completed processing the filtered and sorted transaction records and is ready to finalize the output file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.DALY(+1))
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the step completes successfully, the new generation of the Daily Transaction File is permanently catalogued and retained for downstream use; if the step fails for any reason, the new generation of the Daily Transaction File is automatically deleted and no partial output is retained

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05R - SORT - Daily Transaction File Output Persistence
rules.Rule_Description: A new generation of the Daily Transaction File is created as output. Its permanent retention depends entirely on whether the step completes successfully — ensuring no partial or corrupt daily file is ever saved.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Backup File (SORTIN: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.BKUP(0)) has a defined record structure and layout
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The SORT utility writes the filtered and sorted transaction records to the new Daily Transaction File (SORTOUT: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.DALY(+1))
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Daily Transaction File inherits and uses the exact same record structure and layout as the Transaction Backup File — no fields are added, removed, or reformatted; the record content remains unchanged

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05R - SORT - Daily Transaction File Record Structure Inheritance
rules.Rule_Description: The Daily Transaction File output must preserve the exact same record layout and structure as the source Transaction Backup File, ensuring no data transformation or reformatting occurs during the extract process.

flowchart TD
    A([JOB START
CardDemo - Daily Transaction Extract Job]):::start

    STEP05R[STEP05R - SORT Utility
Filter Transactions by Processing Date
Sort by Card Number]:::process

    DEC1{Transaction Processing Date
Equals 2022-06-02?}:::decision

    EXCL[Record Excluded
Transaction Not Processed on June 2 2022]:::error

    SORT[Sort Included Transactions
By Card Number - Ascending Order]:::process

    SRC[(AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.BKUP
Transaction Backup File
Current Generation - All Transactions)]:::datasource

    TGT[(AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.DALY
Daily Transaction File
New Generation - June 2 2022 Only)]:::datasource

    Z([JOB END
Daily Transaction Extract Complete
New Generation of Daily File Created]):::final

    A --> STEP05R
    SRC -.->|Read All Transaction Records| STEP05R
    STEP05R --> DEC1
    DEC1 -->|No - Exclude Record| EXCL
    DEC1 -->|Yes - Include Record| SORT
    SORT -.->|Write Filtered & Sorted Transactions| TGT
    TGT --> Z
